decrees.title: The Goldyard league against slavers

decrees.edict: When you settle accounts, discard each Slaves commission whose route passes through the affected area. This is a breach.

petitions.text: One of your Slaves routes is spared this round.

petitions.title: Manumission
petitions.text: Discard one of your Slaves commissions and gain gold equal to its income. This is not a breach.

petitions.title: Oath of abolition
petitions.text: Close your Slaves trade for good and open another trade with no overhead. The league becomes law: keep this card face up; its edict lasts the rest of the game.
